summary.text: Camera Bartolotta is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania State Senate, representing District 46 since December 1, 2014, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Jodi Borello of the Independent Party.

paragraphs.text: Camera Bartolotta advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
Ballotpedia reports that her 2014 campaign website highlighted job creation, reform of state government, protecting taxpayers, focusing state spending on priorities and promoting energy independence.
